senses.gloss:
m. (-स्त्यः)
1 KUVERA.
2 RĀVAṆA.
3 Either of the brothers of RĀVAṆA, VIBHĪṢAṆA or KUMBHAKARṆA.
f. (-स्ती)
The sister of RĀVAṆA, ŚŪRPANAKHĀ.
E.
पुलस्त्य a saint so named, and अण् aff. of descent.

mf. (-लिः-ली)
Grain half dressed, or scorched or fried with Ghee, and made into a sort of cake.
E.
पौल a heap, इञ् aff., and ङीप् added for the fem.; also with कन added पौलिका.

f. (-का)
A sort of cake: see the last.

f. (-मी)
The wife of INDRA.
E.
पुलोमन् a saint, the father of the goddess, अण् and ङीप् affs.
